svg.title: How xagent topics work
svg.desc:
How xagent topics work A topic is a named room in the shared conversations workspace States shown: Live. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Project topic (chosen from the session's directory; joined on start): 1. Configured path ([[projects]] path maps to a topic); 2. Git checkout name (a linked worktree counts as its main checkout); 3. scratch (no project, no git) - Topics (one NATS subject each: xagent.v1.chat.conversations.<topic>): webapp (project root topic); webapp.api (child: dotted name); sendmessage (mirrors Claude SendMessage) - Catch-up: topic_history (reads old posts, adds nothing to the inbox) - Subscriber inboxes (a subscription starts now, with no history): Session A (webapp); Session B (webapp + webapp.api); Session C (webapp.api only) - Send result: receivers (count of subscribers reached); receivers: 0 (warning: nobody receives); message_reply (stays in the same thread) Lines: - Project topic -> Topics, labeled "auto-join root" - Topics -> Subscriber inboxes, labeled "message_send" - Subscriber inboxes -> Topics, labeled "topic_subscribe (children opt-in, persists)" - Topics -> Catch-up
